display_name: 复数增益不变损失：多尺度频谱恢复匹配消融
description: 与已登记复数频谱网络相同源记录、信道、预算和结构；只更改为复数增益不变的源波形训练损失，并用 ±64 点对齐 IQ MSE 源域选模。

data.version: original7/63/30 Phase1 source physical ID contract
data.representation: float32 IQ [2,256]; source L_s/U_s paired clean and simulated post_sync residual channel
data.tx_sets_ref: Six registered Phase1 TX; no TX labels used in training or source IQ selection

permissions.query_use: Phase1 test only after source-IQ selection frozen and all predictions sealed; no Phase3
permissions.claim_scope: Single-seed Phase1 development evaluation; historical test observations mean not independent blind

checkpoint.initialization: new mask scratch; DURA frozen; Tri-SIG-TIME SSL used only after source IQ selection
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: prior.frozen_dura validates original 7/63/30 source-only lineage; core.data matches exact Tri-SIG-TIME role IDs
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Frozen designated Phase1 source contract; previous Phase1 development results observed, no clean-blind claim
checkpoint.selection_rule: 源验证接收机4/6、day3，clean及各受损场景分别满足 ±64 点对齐 IQ MSE 不升；选择三个受损场景平均 MSE 之和最大改善；F 权重与 TX 标签均在选择封存后读取。

dimensions: clean and six Phase1 practical scenes
source real L_s and confident U_s pseudo targets
metrics_plan.scientific_rule: 选中的候选完成七视图 truth-last 评分；报告与 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL clean 的百分点和相对 3% 差距，和逐记录 DURA 净修复。源选模直接使用与源评估一致的 ±64 对齐 IQ MSE。

rows.method: same two-resolution bounded complex masks; gain-invariant central IQ loss and deviation penalty; F/TX-free training and source IQ selection
rows.seed_notes: Support null: Phase1 no support. Evaluation seed controls simulated receiver hardware; source sample/augmentation/model seeds fixed; baseline model seed 2026092701.
rows.scenario: source clean plus three impaired views; seven Phase1 final test views only if source IQ selects mask

notes: Matched ablation uses same source physical IDs, channel/hardware seeds, model initialization and training budget as r02.
The new source loss and source selection follow observed r02 source outcomes; final Phase1 test is nonblind development, not a clean generalization claim.
No classifier weights/outputs or TX labels are used during training and source IQ candidate selection.
If source IQ selection retains DURA, no new candidate or Phase1 test is launched.
